answer_1.quote: In opinion summarisation, fair models should represent diverse opinions proportionally to their source documents

answer_2.quote: the quality of the generated summaries is evaluated through comparison with the corresponding reference summaries using two automatic evaluation metrics, ROUGE, an n-gram overlapping metric, and, BERTScore, an embedding-based evaluation metric

answer_4.quote: We conduct a systematic comparison of output fairness across five pruning methods using human evaluation
answer_4.guideline: annotators identified distinct positive and negative opinions in each input, then assess which summary better preserves the original opinion distribution
